method: Held-out set: none of these sites informed any extraction change. Same rules as bench/sites.json. primary: sourced brand colours actually painted on the live homepage (bench/evidence.mjs, dE <= 3 at 1280x800); colourSource says whether the hex is stated in official material or only in secondary sources. An empty list means no sourced colour is painted, so colour is not scored. font: the family that renders body copy (first family in the computed stack with a loaded face). Collected 2026-11-04.
